name: Bonfire Naples

sources.observed: Visually inspected beige textured south wall, brown parapet band, east elevated door with steps and black rails, utility pipes and service yard.
Southwest view: largely blank textured wall, red/gold lettered signs on both faces, recessed west entrance with dark canopy, narrow paved apron.
Official public room photo shows three pool tables, dark exposed ceiling, large square tiles and cone pendants. Exact room layout not established.
Official address610EastNaples and public bar/music/pool uses.
